shared_elements: animal or quadruped shown in profile
small human-like figure with limbs outstretched
justification: Both surfaces carry repeated profile animal figures, small schematic anthropomorphs and isolated disc motifs distributed over a rock face, and both group some marks into loose horizontal rows. However, A is a deliberately framed vertical monolith with modelled, volumetric relief arranged in tidy stacked registers, whereas B is a flat sloping panel covered in thin, flat red linear drawings scattered at varied orientations, so the manner of execution and compositional logic scarcely correspond.
